explanation: By definition (`plusLift` at Plus.lean:278) `J.plusLift γ hR = J.plusMap γ ≫ (J.isoToPlus R hR).inv`, so both sides of the statement are instances of `plusMap_comp` (`J.plusMap (η ≫ γ) = J.plusMap η ≫ J.plusMap γ`, Plus.lean:179) with the second morphism taken to be `J.plusMap γ ≫ (J.isoToPlus R hR).inv`: LHS `J.plusMap η ≫ (J.plusMap γ ≫ inv)` vs RHS `(J.plusMap η ≫ J.plusMap γ) ≫ inv`, equal by associativity. Unfolding `plusLift`, rewriting with `plusMap_comp` and reassociating closes it in one line. No declaration states this result verbatim (the `sheafifyMap_sheafifyLift` lemmas in Sheafification.lean / ConcreteSheafification.lean concern `sheafifyMap`/`sheafifyLift`, a different pair of definitions, and a search of all uses of `plusLift` shows only `toPlus_plusLift`, `plusLift_unique`, `isoToPlus_inv`, `plusCompIso_inv_eq_plusLift`, none of which is this statement); the current proof instead goes through `plusLift_unique`, `toPlus_naturality` and `toPlus_plusLift`.
